summary: The validator note states useful future replay requirements, primitive-record obligations, and failure conditions, but the frozen package remains design-only and supplies no executable independently authored validator, implemented raw-artifact schema, fault-injection attestation, or path/artifact/source-independence evidence. TASK-027 establishes that the current at-most-24-bit regime is inapplicable and cannot authorize a solver run; TASK-028 supplies a source-faithful system map and a derived sound acceptance filter but leaves complete recovery, exceptional-locus orchestration, generalized-root cost, rank, sparse linear algebra, and the common-unit baseline unresolved. Consequently an independent validator cannot yet recompute a decisive claim or certify relation/recovery equivalence, so the proposal is blocked without authorizing compute or retention.
